figurative_meaning_en: To shake off bodily stiffness or numbness
example_sentences_in_bangla: দীর্ঘক্ষণ বসে থাকার পর সে উঠে আড় ভাঙল।
শীতের সকালে ঘুম থেকে উঠে আড় ভাঙতে হয়।
example_sentences_in_english: After sitting for hours, he stood up to shake off the stiffness.
On a cold morning, you need to shake off the stiffness after waking up.
note: This idiom reflects common experiences in rural or travel contexts in Bengali culture.
